title: Gateway
safeHtml:
'''Gateway (Referred to as "Gwy" in this wiki)''' is a Station Class in Los Sengas. It is a class below Terminals, and is followed by Checkpoints. This station class is only applicable for Nazca Railway, and currently there are 8 "Gateway-class" stations.<!--The number of Gateway-Class Stations will increase to 24 in the future.</ref>--> All "Group 1" Gateway Stations make use of a unique Platform Screen Door color, and originally had ordinary Platform Screen Doors, but they were later redesigned to have unique colors.</ref> whereas all existing "Group 2" Gateway Stations make use of unique glass colors next to the track.

It should also be noted that all Gateway Stations are designed to be located at a 20-km, a 50-km or a 100-km radius from Metropolis Terminal, with the Terminal being at the center of the radius.

Definition and Characteristics of Gateways

There are some glasses inside each group of Gateways that are painted with the Gateway's respective colors. Group 1 Gateways have these colored glasses installed on platform screen doors, while Group 2 Gateways have these glasses installed behind the tracks.

is Line Number 23 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. This line has 10 stations, and was established on July 16 2021. It runs between and .

Description

is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Peckern North, and will extend to the east and the west in the future.

This route is represented by Spring Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 23.

History

Origins

This line was first proposed by the developers in Peckern North at the end of 2018. Initial plans of this line involves a route highly similar to the current route, with the main purpose of this line being connecting and together. Earliest plans of this line involved direct connections to the large construction project in East Dansein. However, due to changes in development plans, this plan was scrapped in 2020 and the connect was instead planned as a branch line.

title: Good Queen Anne Memorial Park
safeHtml:
'''Good Queen Anne Memorial Park''' is a park located between Diamond Pool and Halozy in Twenty-Second Continent. It is named after Anne, the first queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

History

The construction of this park aimed to address the lack of recreational facilities in the Halozy and Diamond Pool areas. The naming of this park had several proposals before finally being named after the wise Queen Anne of the United Kingdom. Anne led an ordinary life, but she was open-minded and promoted the overall development of the United Kingdom Parliament, earning widespread affection from the people and the title of "Good" Queen. The last British monarch to receive the title "Good" was Elizabeth I.

  • January 17 2020: Construction of the park began.
  • January 20 2020: The park was completed.

Facilities

The park is equipped with various fitness facilities for public use.

  • 4 standard grass football fields
  • 4 hard surface tier-3 tennis courts
  • 16 basketball courts
  • 6 grass bowling lanes
  • 4 volleyball courts
  • Forest park
  • Training swimming pool with stands
  • Central lawn

Opening Hours

Generally, the park is open 24 hours a day.

Fun Facts

  • Anne Park Station is named after this park.

Fun Facts

  • Exits A and B of this station adopts a crowd control pattern due to the construction of two large stadiums near this station. An extra-wide slope is adopted at the two exits, and a fence is used to separate the two sides in order to divert passenger flow to and from the two stadiums under special circumstances. A similar arrangement would be used at Eclipse Fields Station.
  • This Station uses a space 1.7 times larger than normal stations regarding the concourse size, and a dual crowd control system is used for Exits A and B, with the two crowd controls leading to each of the respective Exits A and B and avoiding each other.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=3861s</ref>
  • The Dual Crowd Control System is marked by red and gray stripes on the ground of the concourse. This indicates that passengers leaving the station are meant to walk at the side closer to the edges, whereas passengers entering the station are meant to walk at the inner side closer to the center.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=3970s</ref>
  • The Station Control Room of this station is located at the west side of this station.
  • Assuming a population density of four people per square meter, this station has a total passenger capacity of 100'000 people, including the exits, concourses and platforms.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=4123s</ref>

was the fifth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between and , and had a total of 11 stations. It was established alongside Main Ruin Station on June 8 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description

was the only spur line among the District Railway lines in Terracept NR. It traveled at the northeast of the Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by Light Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 2A.

At the time of its closure, this route was 9.47 km long, with a total of 11 stations.

Fun Facts

  • This line was established as a spur line of connecting between and . However, after the construction of at , this line became a line on its own right and was renamed "Grand Ruin Line". Nevertheless, despite being an independent line, the line number remained unchanged.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend one more station from station, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

Fun Facts

  • While this station was originally planned to be an Elevated Station, it ultimately became a ground station due to the following factors:
  • Having an elevated station in this area would affect the villagers at the naturally spawned Village between Flask East Checkpoint and this station due to noise pollution.
  • At the time of this station's construction, the plans of crossing Splended River would involve an undersea tunnel, and the height change involved from an elevated station to an undersea tunnel would be too large.
  • This station alludes to Tsuen Wan Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
